name: matrix_power_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::matrix_power.out(Tensor self, int n, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Raises square matrices to an integer power and writes into out. Tests cover output identity, preallocated output storage, empty-output resize, unbatched and batched matrices, and identity, even, and odd powers, accepted floating dtype conversion, and rejected integer output buffers.
